title: Yellowed Roasted Korean Celeriac Tagine
description: A kid-friendly Korean dish featuring roasted celeriac in a flavorful tagine, infused with dashi extract and melted cheese. This raw-friendly recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together dashi extract, gochujang, soy sauce, and brown sugar.
Add the cubed celeriac to the bowl and toss to coat with the sauce.
Transfer the celeriac to a clay tagine vessel and roast in the oven for 30 minutes.
Remove the tagine from the oven and top the celeriac with shredded mozzarella cheese.
Return the tagine to the oven and continue roasting for an additional 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
While the tagine is roasting, heat a small skillet over medium heat and cook the minced garlic and grated ginger until fragrant.
Remove the tagine from the oven and sprinkle the cooked garlic and ginger over the top.
Garnish with chopped green onions and sesame seeds before serving.
